papers.title: AutoDev: Automated AI-Driven Development
papers.tldr: AutoDev is an AI-driven software development framework that automates complex engineering tasks within a secure Docker environment, achieving high performance in code and test generation.

papers.title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
papers.tldr: RSI-Anything leverages predictive world models to guide action selection and adaptive learning, enabling recursive self-improvement across coding, interface navigation, laboratory planning, and scientific optimization tasks.

papers.title: Any Time, Any Space: A World-State-Centric Framework for Agentic Video Generation
papers.tldr: ATAS improves long-form video consistency by compiling screenplays into referenced shot requests, retrieving spatial and temporal evidence from scene and event memories, and conditionally updating memory after generation.

papers.title: The Other Half of the Memory Wall: Serving 35B MoEs from SSD with Trained Routing Prediction
papers.tldr: Edge0 enables efficient mixture-of-experts inference on consumer hardware by predicting expert routing ahead of time and using recovery adapters to maintain quality with minimal active memory.

papers.title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
papers.tldr: A multi-agent framework using large language models for stock trading simulates real-world trading firms, improving performance metrics like cumulative returns and Sharpe ratio.

papers.title: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
papers.tldr: Player-1 improves game control by combining supervised fine-tuning on gameplay trajectories with reinforcement learning across synthetic environments, achieving substantial gains over demonstration-only baselines.

papers.title: Urbex: Agentic Spatial Grounding for City-Scale 3D Scenes
papers.tldr: Urbex reframes city-scale 3D grounding as an active search process using a vision-language agent with reinforcement learning, improving accuracy and speed without precomputed proposals.

papers.title: nanoMuse: An Open-Source Personal Agent for Every Device You Own
papers.tldr: Assistants from 2011 answered and waited, and agents from 2023 did a task and stopped.

papers.title: Unlimited OCR Works
papers.tldr: Unlimited OCR introduces Reference Sliding Window Attention to eliminate growing memory consumption during long-sequence OCR tasks, enabling efficient transcription of multiple pages in a single forward pass.

papers.title: YuE2: Unifying Symbolic and Audio Music Generation at Frontier Quality
papers.tldr: YuE2 unifies symbolic and audio music generation via symbolic planning, producing readable scores and full-song audio with state-of-the-art quality and agentic editing capabilities.

papers.title: VideoJev: System One Model for Video Understanding and Interaction
papers.tldr: VideoJev converts video observations into structured decisions by scoring temporal intervals and text options, enabling efficient reusable inference for visual agents.

papers.title: OpenDevin: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist Agents
papers.tldr: OpenDevin is a platform for developing AI agents that interact with the world by writing code, using command lines, and browsing the web, with support for multiple agents and evaluation benchmarks.

papers.title: Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness
papers.tldr: This survey unifies research on agentic robots by tracing the evolution from robot policies to integrated systems using vision-language-action models, world models, and structured functional domains.

papers.title: Bitnet.cpp: Efficient Edge Inference for Ternary LLMs
papers.tldr: Bitnet.cpp enhances edge inference for ternary LLMs using a novel mixed-precision matrix multiplication library, achieving significant speed improvements over baselines.

papers.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
papers.tldr: PagedAttention algorithm and vLLM system enhance the throughput of large language models by efficiently managing memory and reducing waste in the key-value cache.

papers.title: MinerU2.5: A Decoupled Vision-Language Model for Efficient High-Resolution Document Parsing
papers.tldr: MinerU2.5, a 1.2B-parameter document parsing vision-language model, achieves state-of-the-art recognition accuracy with computational efficiency through a coarse-to-fine parsing strategy.

papers.title: Jeva: System One Models from First Principles
papers.tldr: Jeva is a decision-native architecture that jointly enforces null-awareness, permutation invariance, option scalability, and cross-request caching for structured decision-making.

papers.title: Agent-Reflex: Teaching Language Agents to Act Reflectively
papers.tldr: Agent-Reflex trains interactive agents to reflect and recover from noisy tool feedback and user corrections through skill discovery, supervised fine-tuning, and on-policy optimization.

papers.title: HuggingFace's Transformers: State-of-the-art Natural Language Processing
papers.tldr: Transformers library provides state-of-the-art Transformer architectures and pretrained models for natural language processing tasks with a unified API and emphasis on extensibility and robust deployment.

papers.title: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
papers.tldr: Kronos, a specialized pre-training framework for financial K-line data, outperforms existing models in forecasting and synthetic data generation through a unique tokenizer and autoregressive pre-training on a large dataset.
